name: Thai Customer Support Classifier
description: Classify Thai customer inquiries into six support categories.
long_description: Billing, technical, account, shipping, refund and general support classification. No approved training corpus is available yet.
author: SLM Studio Team
prompt: Classify Thai customer support tickets into billing, technical, account, shipping, refund, or general.
unavailable_reason: No verified licensed Thai six-label dataset.

name: Invoice & Receipt QA Extractor
description: Extract invoice and receipt fields through question answering.
long_description: Thai/English invoice questions about vendors, dates, line items, totals and taxes. Current data covers English synthetic invoices only.
author: SLM Studio Team
prompt: Answer questions about vendor, invoice number, date, line items, total and tax using the invoice text.
unavailable_reason: English synthetic invoices only; Thai coverage is missing.

name: Function Calling Agent
description: Translate requests into API calls for users, orders and products.
long_description: Typed API parameter extraction for CRUD operations. The prepared starter data does not cover the complete requested CRUD scope.
author: SLM Studio Team
prompt: Map user requests to function calls with extracted parameters for users, orders and products APIs.

name: Product Knowledge Base QA
description: Answer product questions using supplied documentation.
long_description: Concise question answering grounded in product documentation. The prepared IBM support starter is not a user's private product knowledge base.
author: SLM Studio Team
prompt: Answer product questions using provided documentation. Be concise and helpful.
unavailable_reason: IBM support starter only; private product knowledge is missing.

name: Thai Sentiment Analyzer
description: Classify Thai text as positive, neutral or negative.
long_description: Balanced Thai sentiment data adapted from Wisesight. Independent validation and test splits are preserved. Model quality has not yet been evaluated.
author: SLM Studio Team
prompt: Classify Thai text sentiment as positive, neutral, or negative. Reply with only the label.

name: Smart Home Assistant Tool Caller
description: Convert smart home commands into device control calls.
long_description: Light, temperature, lock and alarm commands. The prepared English starter covers light, lock and temperature; alarm coverage is missing.
author: SLM Studio Team
prompt: Convert natural language smart home commands into structured device control tool calls.
unavailable_reason: No alarm examples; English synthetic light/lock/temperature data only.

name: Medical Symptom Triage
description: A proposed four-level symptom triage classification template.
long_description: Emergency, urgent, routine and self-care labels. No verified training source or clinical validation is available; this template cannot be used.
author: SLM Studio Team
prompt: Classify symptoms as emergency, urgent, routine or self-care.
unavailable_reason: No verified four-level clinical triage training source.
